literature_scope.role: Aronow–Samii §8 Proposition 8.1 and equation (16), and Sävje v2 §4.3 Definition 1, support averaging potential outcomes over assignments conditional on exposure under the design. Hudgens–Halloran §3.1 gives a related average conditional on own treatment under a group assignment strategy.
limitations: Hudgens–Halloran §2.1 assumes no interference between groups. The project specializes the design-averaging idea to a node and arm in a fixed pretreatment network.
The project arm mean allows potential outcomes to differ within the arm. The project contract specifies the target and support requirements for each case.
R1a and the D/E identifiers are project labels. The cited passages do not establish software coverage.
